=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}" ASSERTIONS_B64="W3sicGF0aCI6Im0zNjVhZ2VudHMueW1sIiwiZXhpc3RzIjp0cnVlLCJjb250YWlucyI6WyJ2ZXJzaW9uOiB2MS4xMiIsImNvcGlsb3RBZ2VudC9wdWJsaXNoIl0sIm5vdENvbnRhaW5zIjpbXX1d" python3 - <<'PY'
import base64
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

project = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve()
assertions = json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ["ASSERTIONS_B64"]).decode("utf-8"))
for assertion in assertions:
    target = (project / assertion["path"]).resolve()
    try:
        target.relative_to(project)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise AssertionError("File assertion escaped the project directory") from error
    exists = target.is_file()
    if exists != assertion["exists"]:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected file existence for {assertion['path']}")
    if not exists:
        continue
    content = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for expected in assertion.get("contains", []):
        expected = expected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if expected not in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected content is absent from {assertion['path']}")
    for unexpected in assertion.get("notContains", []):
        unexpected = unexpected.replace("__VSCUSE_APP_NAME__", project.name)
        if unexpected in content:
            raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected content is present in {assertion['path']}")
PY
```

parameters.sample:
=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}" WORKFLOW_VERSION="v1.9" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path

workflow_file = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"]).resolve() / "m365agents.yml"
target = "version: " + os.environ["WORKFLOW_VERSION"]
lines = workflow_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
matches = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith("version:")]
if len(matches) != 1:
    raise AssertionError("The workflow must contain exactly one top-level version")
lines[matches[0]] = target
workflow_file.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
written = workflow_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
if [line for line in written if line.startswith("version:")] != [target]:
    raise AssertionError("The workflow version was not written exactly once")
PY
```
